agentPageLoading.message: Reading the list of agents and tasks.

pairingCompare.message: Confirm only if the agent shows the same code. A different code: decline.

pairingExpired.message: This request expired. The agent has to ask again.

pairingConfirmed.message: Access for agent $NAME$ is confirmed. The agent has five minutes to collect its key.

pairingDeclined.message: The request from agent $NAME$ was declined.

agentRevoked.message: Access for agent $NAME$ was revoked and its tasks closed.

pairingHow.message: An agent asks for access with okolos-agent pair --name "<name>" in a terminal. Its code then appears here. The door's address: $URL$

pairingStoreError.message: The access list cannot be read: $WHAT$. Until it is fixed, every call that carries a key ends in an Okolos Agent failure: the key cannot be checked. New access requests are not taken. Run okolos-agent doctor to see what is wrong with the file.

tasksEmpty.message: No agent has an open task now.

taskTimeOver.message: The task's time is up, and Okolos Agent is closing its window

refusalsEmpty.message: The agents' journal has no refusals or failures.

refusal_verb_not_in_task.message: the task does not allow this

refusal_budget_exhausted.message: the task ran out of steps

refusal_busy.message: Okolos Agent was busy with another task

refusal_in_use_by_person.message: you were using the agent window

refusal_browser_offline.message: the agents' Chrome did not start or did not answer

refusal_cleaning_incomplete.message: cleaning did not finish; no text was given

refusal_stale_cursor.message: the cursor is not from the latest snapshot

eventStopping.message: Okolos Agent is stopping and takes on no new work.

eventDrainCutOff.message: Okolos Agent stopped before all calls finished. Cut off: $COUNT$.

serviceStopping.message: Okolos Agent is stopping and takes on no new work. Try again once it has started.

eventsUnreadable.message: The events file had unreadable lines: $COUNT$. They were removed at start.

pairingCollecting.message: Confirmed. The key waits for the agent until $TIME$.

pairingClaimExpired.message: The key was not collected within five minutes. No access was given; the agent has to ask again.

pairingDuplicate.message: The name looks like another request's name. Compare the code with special care.

rejection_bad_host.message: the call was not addressed to Okolos Agent

rejection_bad_origin.message: the call carried an Origin header, as a web page does

rejection_cross_site.message: the call carried Sec-Fetch-* headers, as a browser does

rejection_bad_content_type.message: the call was in the wrong format

rejection_bad_request.message: the call could not be read

rejection_not_paired.message: the call had no valid access key

journalError.message: The agents' journal could not be written: $WHAT$. Until a write succeeds, every agent call ends in an Okolos Agent failure and no page content is given to agents. Run okolos-agent doctor to see what is wrong with the journal.

pairingLooksLikeAgent.message: A similar name is among the agents with access, listed below. Compare the code with special care.

agentRevokeFailed.message: Access for agent $NAME$ was not revoked: the access list could not be written. The agent can still work. Try again. If it fails, run okolos-agent doctor.

verb_get.message: get an address, title, text or element count

rejection_store_unreadable.message: the access list could not be read; the key was not checked

journalUnreadable.message: The agents' journal cannot be read: $WHAT$. Refusals and failures are not shown here. Run okolos-agent doctor to see what is wrong with the journal.

journalDayFull.message: The agents' journal is full until 00:00 UTC: it holds 5000 agent entries for the day. Until then every agent call ends in an Okolos Agent failure, and no page content reaches agents.

refusalsIncomplete.message: This list is incomplete: while writes to the agents' journal fail, refusals and failures are not recorded.

pageSessionExpired.message: The page session expired. Open Okolos Agent again in Fabric Dashboards.

pageStopping.message: Okolos Agent is stopping. Open the page again once it has started.

taskProfileAgent.message: Agent profile: persistent and shared by agents with access; what sites keep between runs stays

taskProfileDisposable.message: Temporary profile, which keeps no sign-ins

journalExportFailed.message: The agents' journal could not be exported: $WHAT$. Run okolos-agent doctor to see what is wrong with the journal.

pairingStoreUnwritable.message: The access list could not be written: $WHAT$. Until a write succeeds, access cannot be given or revoked; agents with access work as before. Run okolos-agent doctor to see what is wrong with the file.

pairingGone.message: This request is gone: it expired, was declined, or the agent has already collected its key.

agentGone.message: This agent no longer has access.

journalLinesSkipped.message: The agents' journal has unreadable lines: $COUNT$. They are skipped here.

refusalsGap.message: From $FROM$ to $TO$ the agents' journal was not written: refusals and failures in that time are not recorded.

refusalDoorFailureLine.message: $WHEN$, Okolos Agent failure at the door: $WHAT$

pairingGrants.message: Access lets the agent open and read, in the agent window, the sites it names in its own tasks, in the agent profile shared by every agent with access, and read this device's process census, without command lines.

refusal_bad_call.message: the call was malformed (an unknown tool, wrong arguments or a protocol error)

refusal_local_answer.message: a site in the task answered from an address on this device or the local network
